newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to move lower at the opening bell Friday, under pressure from weakness in high techs, incuding industry giant Intel Corp.
Analysts said that yesterday's poor close indicated that the current rally was running out of steam and that interest rate worries had put earnings on the back burner.
Investors will be bracing for a week larded with economic data, including the April NAPM and employment report, due out next Thursday and Friday, respectively.
